title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
summary: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

overrides.data_affected: Refrigeration / OT control systems (no customer data reported stolen)
overrides.impact: Hundreds of supermarket branches; fresh and frozen stock worth millions of euros spoiled.
overrides.prevention: Segment OT/IoT networks from corporate IT, disable default remote maintenance access, and monitor industrial controllers for anomalous commands.

title: SolarWinds supply-chain hack breaches US government networks
summary: Attackers inserted a backdoor into widely-used network-management software, compromising numerous US government agencies and companies in a stealthy espionage campaign.

overrides.data_affected: Government and corporate email and internal systems
overrides.impact: Thousands of organisations ran the trojanised update; multiple US agencies were breached.
overrides.prevention: Verify build integrity and code signing, generate SBOMs, isolate build pipelines, and monitor for anomalous outbound traffic.

title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
summary: State-backed operators impersonated executives on deepfake video calls to trick employees into approving fraudulent cryptocurrency transfers worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

overrides.impact: Over $400 million in crypto stolen from exchanges and funds via social engineering.
overrides.prevention: Verify high-value transfer requests out-of-band, require dual authorization, and train staff to treat unexpected video calls as untrusted.

title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
summary: A stealthy group compromised telecom infrastructure to intercept SMS one-time codes, defeating 2FA and enabling surveillance of targeted users.

overrides.data_affected: SMS one-time codes, 2FA tokens and private communications
overrides.impact: Telecom networks hijacked to intercept 2FA codes and spy on targeted Taiwanese users.
overrides.prevention: Replace SMS 2FA with phishing-resistant (FIDO2) MFA, and harden and monitor signalling (SS7/Diameter) interconnects.

title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
summary: An international law-enforcement operation dismantled malware infrastructure and recovered millions of stolen credentials harvested by info-stealers.

overrides.data_affected: 6.4 million stolen logins and session tokens
overrides.impact: Info-stealer botnets (Gootloader, CastleRAT, StealC) seized; 6.4M credentials recovered.
overrides.prevention: Rotate credentials exposed to info-stealers, enforce MFA everywhere, and block execution of unsigned loaders on endpoints.

title: Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
summary: Tampered hardware wallets sold through a third-party reseller contained hidden implants capable of exfiltrating users' recovery phrases.

overrides.data_affected: Cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases / private keys
overrides.impact: Resold hardware wallets carried implants able to steal recovery phrases and drain funds.
overrides.prevention: Buy hardware wallets only from the vendor or authorised sellers, and verify tamper-evidence and firmware signatures before first use.

title: How Fake Job Interviews Helped Hackers Pull Off a $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist
summary: Operatives used fake job interviews and malicious coding tasks to plant malware on developers at crypto firms, enabling one of the largest cryptocurrency thefts on record.

overrides.data_affected: Developer workstations, signing keys and cryptocurrency funds
overrides.impact: Fake-recruiter malware led to a multi-billion-dollar cryptocurrency heist.
overrides.prevention: Verify recruiters and candidates out-of-band, run coding tasks only in isolated throwaway VMs, and protect signing keys with hardware and multi-signature.
